meta.name: PM C13 - tighten mark max-delta cap to 5%
meta.description: setMarkMaxDeltaBps(500) on PerpEngine — lowers the per-push mark move cap from 1500 bps (15%) to 500 bps (5%). At 1500 a single max-legal adverse push liquidates a 5x short (margin ratio 434 bps < 500 bps maintenance); at 500 it takes three. Matches the composer's own configured 5% cap, so no legitimate push is affected. No timelock — takes effect on execution.
